operating_notes.text: NTPC Green Energy Limited Group commercial capacity stands at 10,363.90 MW as of April 2026.
NTPC commercialised 100 MW out of 176 MW solar capacity at Ramagundam, taking total installed capacity to 89,805 MW.
NTPC acquired the remaining 26% stake in NTPC EDMC Waste Solutions Private Limited for ₹5.20 lakh, making it a 100% subsidiary.
NTPC group installed capacity reached 89,868 MW and commercial capacity 88,788 MW after NGEL step-down subsidiaries commissioned solar capacity in Rajasthan.
NGEL Group commercial capacity stands at 10,453.90 MW, with total installed capacity rising to 10,516.40 MW.
PVUNL Unit-2 (800 MW) successfully completed trial run operation, taking NTPC group installed capacity to 90,668 MW.
NGEL FY27 capex is planned at ₹35,800 Cr and FY28 capex at ₹46,000 Cr.
NTPC group total installed capacity reached 90,773 MW and commercial capacity 88,893 MW after commissioning 105 MW solar capacity at Khavda-II.
NTPC received ₹5.31 lakh fines each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with board composition rules in Q4FY26.
NTPC group total installed capacity reached 90,807 MW and commercial capacity 88,927 MW after commissioning 34.4 MW solar capacity at Ramagundam.
NTPC and UPRVUNL signed SJVA-III for Meja Urja Nigam Private Limited to expand Meja Stage-II capacity from 2x660 MW to 3x800 MW.
NTPC group's total installed capacity increased to 91,030 MW with commercial capacity at 89,950 MW
NTPC coal stations achieved PLF of 72.04% in FY26 against All-India coal PLF of 69.95%, with declared capacity above 85%.
Trade receivables fell to 34 days in FY26 from 45 days in FY25, with 100% realisation of about ₹1.56 lakh Cr during FY26.
Captive coal production was 48.66 MMT in FY26, with about 18% of coal requirements supplied from captive mines.
NTPC Green Energy declared COD of 50 MW solar capacity in Rajasthan w.e.f. 31 July 2026 as part of 100 MW RE RTC project
FY26 group capex was ₹49,000 Cr (standalone ₹28,462 Cr), up from ₹44,636 Cr (₹22,965 Cr) in FY25.
NTPC group has 38.9 GWh of BESS portfolio, including 6.62 GWh under execution and 5 GWh co-located at thermal stations under regulated returns.
Pudimadakka green hydrogen hub spans 1,200 acres with an envisaged investment of around ₹1 lakh Cr.
NTPC Green Energy declared COD of 6.3 MW wind capacity in Gujarat with effect from 00:00 hrs of 13.09.2026
NTPC Green Energy declared COD of 68.22 MW solar capacity in Gujarat w.e.f. 23 July 2026
NTPC Green Energy declared COD of 9.45 MW wind capacity in Gujarat w.e.f. 19 September 2026
Total installed capacity of NTPC Green Energy Limited group increased to 10,920.53 MW
NTPC Green Energy declared commercial operation of 50.4 MW Jamjodhpur Wind Energy Project in Gujarat w.e.f. 22 September 2026
Total installed capacity of NTPC Green Energy Limited group increased to 10,977.23 MW with this addition
NTPC Green Energy declares commercial operation of 81.34 MW solar capacity at Kalasar, Rajasthan
NTPC Green Energy declared commercial operation of 73.06 MW and 80.88 MW of the Kalasar Solar Energy Project, Bikaner, Rajasthan, w.e.f. 00:00 hrs of 01.10.2026
NGEL group installed capacity 11,262.51 MW and commercial capacity 11,212.51 MW after 50 MW solar commissioning in Rajasthan
The 50 MW is the fourth tranche of a 300 MW solar component within a 200 MW RTC project of Project Sixteen Renewable Power Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary of ONGC NTPC Green Private Limited
NTPC Green Energy declared commercial operation of 66.18 MW solar capacity at Kalasar project, Bikaner, Rajasthan, w.e.f. 00:00 hrs of 10.10.2026
NVVN's first BESS project (250 MW / 500 MWh) declared commercial with power scheduling from 28 October 2026

timeline.summary: NTPC commissioned 90 MW of solar capacity at the Khavda-II project in Gujarat, bringing group installed capacity to 89,705 MW.
NTPC commissioned 100 MW of solar capacity at Ramagundam, taking group installed capacity to 89,805 MW.
On 7th May 2026, NTPC agreed to acquire MCD's 26% stake in NTPC EDMC Waste Solutions Private Limited for ₹0.052 Cr to make it a wholly owned subsidiary.
On 15 May 2026, NTPC announced the commercial operation of 62.5 MW of solar capacity across step-down subsidiaries, taking total installed capacity to 89,868 MW.
NTPC commissioned Unit-2 (800 MW) of Patratu Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited, taking group capacity to 90,668 MW.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹49,687.77 Cr (-0.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹10,486.47 Cr (+37.8% YoY).
2026-05-23: NTPC held Q4FY26 results conference call with analysts and investors
NTPC held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on 23 May 2026, outlining capacity addition plans and NGEL capex.
NTPC group total installed capacity reached 90,773 MW on 28 May 2026 after commissioning the final 105 MW part of the Khavda-II Solar PV Project.
NTPC received ₹5.31 lakh fines each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) board composition rules for Q4FY26.
NTPC commissioned the 34.4 MW second part of the Ramagundam Solar PV Project, taking total group installed capacity to 90,807 MW.
NTPC signed SJVA-III with UPRVUNL on 4 June 2026 to expand Meja Stage-II JV capacity from 2x660 MW to 3x800 MW.
THDC India Limited commissioned an 11 MWac floating solar plant on the Raw Water Reservoir of Khurja STPP with commercial operation from 17 July 2026.
NTPC Green Energy commissioned 64.76 MW solar capacity at Khavda, Gujarat on 24 July 2026
NTPC reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹50,741 Cr and PAT of ₹6,896 Cr
NTPC board approved raising up to ₹12,000 Cr through non-convertible debentures, subject to shareholder approval
NTPC released Q1FY27 operational and financial results on 24 July 2026
NTPC's 22nd Annual Analysts Meet presentation set out a Corporate Plan 2037 target of 136 GW capacity and ₹16.86 lakh Cr of capex, from 90.90 GW operating at 30 June 2026.
NTPC Green Energy declared commercial operation date for 50 MW solar capacity in Rajasthan effective 31 July 2026, increasing group commercial capacity to 90,000 MW.
NTPC published FY26 annual results showing flat revenue and 15% PAT growth driven by tax benefit
NTPC Ltd’s 50th AGM held on 27th August 2026 via VC/OAVM, chaired by **Gurdeep Singh (Chairman & Managing Director)** with 281 attendees including President of India’s representative.
NTPC Ltd’s 50th AGM on 27-Aug-2026 passed all resolutions unanimously, including audited financials, dividends, and auditor reports.
NTPC reported three senior management cessations on 31st August 2026
NTPC Green Energy declared COD of 6.3 MW wind capacity in Gujarat on 13 September 2026, taking NTPC group installed capacity to 91,086 MW.
NTPC Green Energy commissions 68.22 MW solar capacity in Gujarat (23 July 2026) and 9.45 MW wind capacity in Gujarat (19 September 2026), increasing total installed capacity to 10,920.53 MW
NTPC Green Energy commissioned 50.4 MW wind capacity in Gujarat on 22 September 2026, increasing group installed capacity to 10,977.23 MW.
NTPC Green Energy declares commercial operation of 81.34 MW solar capacity at Kalasar, Rajasthan on 26 September 2026, increasing NTPC group installed capacity to 91,302 MW

NTPC Green Energy declared commercial operation of 153.94 MW solar capacity at Kalasar Solar Energy Project, Bikaner, Rajasthan, w.e.f. 1 October 2026, increasing NTPC group installed capacity to 91,456 MW.
NTPC announced cessation of four senior management members effective September 2026

NTPC Green Energy declared commercial operation of the fourth 50 MW tranche of the 300 MW solar component of its 200 MW RTC project in Rajasthan w.e.f. 2 October 2026, taking NTPC group installed capacity to 91,506 MW.
NTPC Green Energy commissioned 66.18 MW solar capacity at Kalasar project in Rajasthan w.e.f. 10 October 2026, increasing NTPC group installed capacity to 91,572 MW.
2026-10-15: NTPC signed a Cooperation Agreement with Africa50 to develop power projects across Africa
NTPC subsidiary NVVN declared commercial operation of its first 250 MW / 500 MWh BESS project effective 27 October 2026.
NTPC Limited Board declared First Interim Dividend of Rs.3 per equity share on 31 October 2026.
NTPC Limited held a conference call on 31 October 2026 discussing results for quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026; audio recording link provided.

watchlist.response: CMD and Director (Finance) declined to explain, offering to discuss it separately; evasive.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked how NTPC holds its weighted average borrowing cost at 5.89%, near the repo rate.

watchlist.response: Management said it prefers brownfield cost-plus projects with assured ~15.5% regulated returns (12-13% net) and fairness to customers.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked why NTPC does not bid for state coal tenders at ₹4+ fixed tariffs that appear to offer high equity IRRs.

watchlist.response: CMD said the 7 GW is already constrained by transmission and argued 7 GW with storage is worth more than 8 GW without.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether the 7 GW FY27 renewable target is achievable given transmission delays.

status_history.evidence: NTPC group installed capacity increased to 91,572 MW with the commissioning of 66.18 MW solar capacity at Kalasar project.
